newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.Africa gasoline prices fall by one cent/litre.
newsitem.headline: S.Africa gasoline prices fall by one cent/litre.

text.p: South Africa's Central Energy Fund said gasoline prices would fall by one cent per litre and diesel would fall by three cents with effect from February 5.
Illuminating paraffin would rise by one cent per litre.
The Central Energy Fund said international prices had held broadly steady but the rand had strrengthened against the dollar, making product slightly cheaper in rand terms.
From February 5 the price of 93 octane gasoline in the Gauteng area around Johannesburg will be 223 cents. At the coast the price goes to 213.
The price of diesel in Gauteng will be 223 cents, and 213 cents on the coast, while illuminating paraffin goes to 149.53 cents in Gauteng. At the coast, illuminating paraffin will be 137.43.
